services.name: Book a Charter
services.desc: Captain Jon offers Chesapeake Bay Charter Fishing at its best, Maryland Rockfish, Striped Bass, Bluefish and Croaker, all with no fishing license needed. Chesapeake Bay charter fishing includes Maryland Rockfish, Striped Bass, Sea Trout, Bluefish, Croaker, Spanish Mackerel, Perch, Spot, Flounder and Black Drum. Many Chesapeake Bay Sport fishing enthusiasts have enjoyed a day on the Chesapeake Bay with Captain Jon. Call Captain Jon and make your Chesapeake Bay charter fishing reservations today.
